title: Canonical finite-free tensor comparison for derived products and strict towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $a:R\to S$ a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings. Suppose $S\cong R^{\oplus d}$ as an $R$-module sheaf for a finite integer $d\geq0$. Use the unbounded module derived categories $D(R),D(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $C=-\otimes_R^L S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $\operatorname{Tow}(R)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R))$, and similarly for $S$. Let $C^{\operatorname{Tow}}:D(\operatorname{Tow}(R))\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(S))$ be induced by termwise tensor, which is exact under the finite-free hypothesis. Write $L_R,L_S$ for total right derived inverse limit with its functorial Roos triangles [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit].

For every countable family $(M_n)$ in $D(R)$, the canonical projection comparison $C(\prod_n^D M_n)\to\prod_n^D C(M_n)$ is an isomorphism in $D(S)$. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\lambda_X:C L_R X\xrightarrow{\sim}L_S C^{\operatorname{Tow}}X\qquad(X\in D(\operatorname{Tow}(R))).$$
It is the total derived-functor comparison induced by the ordinary limit/tensor comparison. It identifies the entire functorial Roos triangles, including the connecting arrows, under the canonical derived-product comparison and the cochain shift comparison of $C$. For a strict augmented tower of complexes $z_n:M\to X_n$, its canonical derived-limit augmentation $z:M\to L_R X$ satisfies $\lambda_X C(z)=z'$, where $z':CM\to L_S C^{\operatorname{Tow}}X$ is induced by the termwise augmented tower $C(z_n)$. These comparisons are independent of a basis and natural in maps of entire augmented towers; no exactness of countable products of sheaves and no boundedness of the complexes are assumed.
